scorecard.rationale: No directly matched directional human Parkinson's evidence qualified. Local lexical pairs: 14. External records screened: 40. Exhaustive Round 1 screening across the local research catalog, Europe PMC, live 2026 PubMed/ClinicalTrials.gov sweeps, and Oracle/external cultural lookups found no qualifying controlled clinical or preclinical signal transferring to dried parsley and Parkinson pain severity. Matched cultural/experiential records (1) provide non-controlled context only. The cancer review names parsley as one source of apigenin. It tests neither dried culinary parsley nor increased pain severity in people with Parkinson disease.
